reason: I already take orders on WhatsApp and keep my udhaar in my diary, and it works for me. Another thing to learn and keep up every day, I don't have the time or patience for it at the counter.
objection: If it reads an order wrong, or I have to tap confirm on every one, it is more work than my diary. And I would be putting all my customers' udhaar into a phone system I don't understand.
would_change_my_mind: If the person who visits sets it up and sits with me for a week, and I see it get my own customers' voice orders right with no extra work from me, I would try the free months.
